name: Dielectric, Ferroelectric & Piezoelectric Materials
summary: Explains polarisation in insulators and the ferroic materials behind capacitors, sensors, actuators and ultrasonic transducers.

topics.name: Dielectric polarisation mechanisms: electronic, ionic, orientational and space-charge
Dielectric constant, loss tangent and frequency dependence
Capacitor dielectrics: BaTiO3 multilayer ceramic capacitors and polymer films
Pyroelectricity and ferroelectricity; hysteresis loops and domains
Perovskite ferroelectrics and the Curie temperature; relaxor ferroelectrics
Piezoelectric effect: constitutive equations, d and g coefficients, coupling factor
Piezoelectric materials: quartz, PZT, PMN-PT single crystals, PVDF and lead-free alternatives
Applications: sensors, ultrasonic transducers, actuators and energy harvesters
